title: pywavfile parser-hardening fixture corpus
format: RIFF/WAVE binary fixtures generated by generate_fixtures.py
expectation_note: Some cases are marked *_or_* because the project must choose and document a policy (e.g. duplicate chunks, unusual but structurally valid ordering, partial frames).

valid_unknown_chunk.wav.note: Unknown odd-sized ancillary chunk; parser must skip payload and pad.

valid_data_before_fmt.wav.note: Data precedes fmt; parser may support deferred format discovery or explicitly reject ordering.

valid_metadata_after_data.wav.note: Metadata follows data; parser should not accidentally treat audio end as container end.

valid_odd_data_chunk.wav.note: Odd-sized data payload is structurally padded; payload itself is not whole PCM frames.

valid_extensible_pcm_stereo.wav.note: WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE with PCM subformat, stereo mask.

valid_extensible_zero_channel_mask.wav.note: Zero channel mask means speaker positions unspecified.

valid_extensible_valid_bits_less_than_co.note: 20 valid bits in a 24-bit container; support requires correct alignment semantics.
